headline: [Exclusive] Selection of Items for 'Korea's IRA' Begins; Opinions on Batteries and Solar Power Gathered
summary: The government has started collecting industry opinions on detailed targets for the domestic production tax credit, known as Korea's IRA. Battery and solar power items are among those under consideration.
why: Domestic production tax credits are subsidies that shape where manufacturers invest and produce, which directly affects battery and solar companies.
